item.title: The Battle Bus Driver In 'Fortnite' Is Apparently Dead, According To Fans Who Watched The Vehicle Explode
item.description: Fortnite Bus Driver Death refers to a series of memes and viral posts honoring the legacy of the imagined driver of the Battle Bus in the video game Fortnite, named Lars.

item.title: Surreal Indie Horror Game 'Horses' Banned From The Humble Store, Marking A Third Ban For The Controversial Game
item.description: Horses is a surrealist horror video game developed and published by Santa Ragione Game Studio in collaboration with filmmaker Andrea Lucco Borlera. The game puts players in the role of a farmhand tending to a farm filled with enslaved people dressed as horses. In November 2025, leading up to the game's December 2nd, 2025 release date, it was reported that Steam refused to distribute the game on its storefront.
